deck_title: Cross-Asset Market Making Desk — Independent Trading-Desk Risk Review

cover.title: Cross-Asset Market Making Desk — Independent Trading-Desk Risk Review
cover.takeaway: Independent review of risk metrics, PnL, post-trade controls, and risk commentary for the Cross-Asset Market Making Desk.

executive_summary.title: Material VaR limit breach and governance concerns require immediate follow-up
executive_summary.takeaway: VaR breach on MOCK_PC_FLOW followed by limit increase effective before approvals; recurring excess events and data inconsistencies raise governance concerns.
executive_summary.limitation: No direct evidence of unauthorized activity; data gaps limit full reconciliation.

risk_metrics.title: VaR limit breach and recurring excess events indicate limit framework misalignment
risk_metrics.takeaway: MOCK_PC_FLOW VaR breached on three consecutive days; limit increase effective before approvals; 9 excess events with 2 open.
risk_metrics.limitation: Utilization uses recorded directional bound; position direction not established.

pnl.title: Large year-end freeze adjustment and period-end concentration warrant review
pnl.takeaway: Adjustment 96600008 (-6.25M EUR, z-score -3.28) is largest; period-end concentration in Dec-2025, Mar-2026, Jun-2026.
pnl.limitation: Absolute amounts do not preserve adjustment direction; EUR conversion mismatches possible.

post_trade_controls.title: Post-trade controls show no approval gaps or unresolved breaches
post_trade_controls.takeaway: All 14 breaches have approval references; no unresolved breaches; mean closure time unavailable due to data limitations.
post_trade_controls.limitation: Each row treated as one breach; status inferred only from valid closure date.

risk_commentary.title: Commentary claim of VaR within appetite conflicts with breach evidence
risk_commentary.takeaway: Validated commentary on 2026-03-27 states no escalation required, but VaR breach occurred same day; 10 records pending validation.
risk_commentary.limitation: Coverage counts finalized extracts only; underlying commentary completeness not implied.

synthesis.title: Moderate risk profile with isolated high-severity governance concerns
synthesis.takeaway: VaR breach and limit increase timing suggest potential control circumvention; post-trade controls robust; data gaps require follow-up.
synthesis.limitation: Unresolved data gaps and missing unique identifiers limit full reconciliation.

closing.title: Immediate actions: investigate limit change, resolve data inconsistencies, validate commentary
closing.takeaway: Obtain limit approval history; investigate recurring breaches; verify Colibris data; review large adjustment; follow up on pending validations.
closing.limitation: Actions based on available evidence; further investigation may reveal additional issues.
